faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: This notification is for the recruitment of Technicians on a contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. at Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for Tuesday, 13th October, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for the interview is 10.00 a.m. to 10.30 a.m.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Meeting Room-2, Khanolkar Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (MLT) or B.Sc. with D.M.L.T., with a minimum of 1-year experience in a hospital being preferable.

faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 30 years, which may be relaxed on an experience basis.

faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from ₹ 26,210 to 35,000/- p.m. based on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The contract duration is 6 months and is extendable as per requirement.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
